name: @qu/space-ui
description: Qu V5: an OPTIONAL, framework-agnostic add-on UI layer over @qu/space-core's Field/SpaceNode API - vanilla JS/DOM, no build step, no virtual DOM, no component framework dependency. bind.js (one/two-way reactive field<->element binding), inline-edit.js (contenteditable with cancel/save), list-bind.js (keyed diff list rendering off a list Field), upload-status.js (file selection + always-visible remote-sync status icons, built on @qu/space-plugins' UploadOutbox). @qu/space-core itself stays completely unaware this package exists - every function here takes a real DOM element and a Field/Node handle and wires listeners/observers, nothing more.
